purpose: Model-free ambiguity-aware post-quantization pitch/voicing diagnosis of the immutable Go My Way V4-origin guitar candidate.

frozenRules.primaryPairing: maximum cardinality first, then minimum total absolute onset error; pitch is not used to select pairs
frozenRules.legacyPairing: retain greedy onset-first assignment only for historical comparability and mark it assignment-dependent
frozenRules.ambiguity: connected onset-eligibility components with any node degree >1 are ambiguous; report pairing-invariant MIDI multiset overlap and ambiguous/unambiguous strata
frozenRules.pitchClassRule: all nonzero multiples of 12 count as pitch-class-correct octave errors; only +/-12 belongs to the disjoint abs12 bucket

requiredAudits: ordered event identity and MIDI equality
combined-target union-exclusion and coincident same-pitch role-target convention
interpretationBoundary: Use original and quantized inputs under identical V2 rules. Separate unmatched target events from wrong pitches among matched events. If ambiguity prevents stable attribution, stop at that finding. No reference-derived prediction correction is authorized by this diagnostic.
